applicant.name: Top End Pacific and Asian Community Association Inc.

project.title: Top End Multicultural Futsal Cup
project.description: A one-day futsal tournament at Marrara Indoor Stadium for international students. Teams will be mixed, with no more than two players from the same country in each team, so students meet people outside their usual circle. Qualified referees will run the games, and a local employment service will host a stall about part-time work rights for students.
project.who_can_attend: Open to all international students studying in the Northern Territory. Entry is free.
project.wellbeing_benefit: Physical activity, new friendships across nationalities, and practical information about working while studying.

budget.item: Lunch and non-alcoholic drinks for 120 players
